backendErrors.cookieBotTouchFingerprintUnsupported: This profile claims a touch device, which the bot cannot drive. Use a desktop fingerprint.
backendErrors.profileRunningRemotely: This profile is running on a remote machine. Stop the remote session first.
backendErrors.profileRemoteSyncPending: A remote session just finished. Waiting for its changes to download before this profile can open here.
backendErrors.profileLockedByMember: This profile is in use by {{email}}.
backendErrors.profileLockedElsewhere: This profile is in use on another device.
backendErrors.profileLockUnavailable: Could not check whether this profile is in use elsewhere. Check your connection and try again.
backendErrors.fingerprintExitMismatch: The proxy exit node doesn't match this profile's fingerprint.
backendErrors.launchConsentExpired: That confirmation is no longer valid. Try launching again.
backendErrors.exitProbeFailed: Couldn't reach the proxy exit node to check its location.

vlessUnsupported.security: This VLESS server does not use REALITY. Donut supports VLESS with REALITY only.
vlessUnsupported.flow: This VLESS server does not use XTLS Vision flow, which Donut requires.

vlessUnsupported.encryption: This VLESS server uses an encryption setting Donut does not support.
vlessUnsupported.headerType: This VLESS server uses a header obfuscation Donut does not support.
vlessUnsupported.fingerprint: This VLESS URI requests a TLS fingerprint Donut does not support.
vlessUnsupported.sni: The VLESS URI is missing the SNI (sni) needed for REALITY.
vlessUnsupported.publicKey: The VLESS URI is missing the REALITY public key (pbk).
vlessUnsupported.scheme: That is not a VLESS link. It must start with vless://.
vlessUnsupported.parameter: The VLESS URI contains an option Donut does not support.

rollover.startedDescription: We're re-uploading every synced item under the new password. Profiles first, then proxies, groups, VPNs, and extensions.
rollover.completedDescription: All synced data is sealed under the new password.

account.signedOutDescription: Sign in to enable cloud sync, encrypted profiles, and team features.

selfHosted.title: Self-hosted sync server
selfHosted.description: Point Donut at your own donut-sync server to sync profiles, proxies, groups, and extensions without using the hosted cloud.
selfHosted.disabledWhileLoggedIn: Self-hosted sync is unavailable while you're signed into your Donut account. Sign out to use a custom server.

account.automationActiveHere: Browser automation is active on this device.

shortcutsPage.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcutsPage.description: Speed up your workflow with these shortcuts.

closeConfirm.title: Close Donut Browser?
closeConfirm.description: Would you like to send the app to the system tray or quit?

createProfile.title: Create your first profile
createProfile.content: Click here to create your first profile. Pick Wayfern as the browser — the recommended, fingerprint-protected Chromium.

dnsBlocking.title: DNS blocking
dnsBlocking.content: Use this dropdown to set a DNS blocklist level for the profile — it blocks ads, trackers, and malware at the network level. Higher levels block more.

thankYou.title: Thank you for choosing Donut Browser
thankYou.body: Hopefully it helps make your browsing more private — every identity kept its own, and nothing leaving your machine. Enjoy.

welcome.title: Welcome to Donut Browser
welcome.tagline: An open-source anti-detect browser for managing many identities at once.

permissions.title: Allow microphone & camera
permissions.desc: Grant access so sites that need a mic or camera work inside your browser profiles. macOS asks once; each site still asks you individually.

ready.title: Setting things up
ready.descDownloading: Downloading your first browser (Wayfern). This one-time setup runs in the background — hang tight.
ready.descReady: Your browser is ready. Let's create your first profile.
ready.descExtracting: Extracting your browser. This one-time setup runs in the background — hang tight.
ready.errorDownload: {{browser}} couldn't be downloaded. Check your connection and try again.
ready.errorExtraction: {{browser}} couldn't be extracted. Please try again.
ready.errorGeneric: Something went wrong while setting up {{browser}}. Please try again.

license.title: Licensing
license.body: Donut Browser is open source and free to use.
license.commercialDesc: Free for a 2-week evaluation. After that, a paid plan keeps the project maintained and thriving.

wayfernBlocked.title: Browser automation paused
wayfernBlocked.description: Browser automation runs on one device at a time, and another signed-in device is currently using it. Sign out there, then relaunch the profile.

wayfernConfigDialog.invalidFingerprintDescription: The fingerprint configuration contains invalid JSON. Please check your advanced settings.

clearOnClose.label: Clear data on close
clearOnClose.description: Wipe cookies, history and cache when the browser closes. Extensions and bookmarks are kept.

consistencyWarning.timezoneDetail: Exit node is in {{exit}} but the fingerprint reports {{fingerprint}}.
consistencyWarning.languageDetail: Exit country is {{country}} but the fingerprint language is {{fingerprint}}.
consistencyWarning.explainer: A timezone or language that disagrees with your exit IP is a strong anti-bot signal, even though your real device never leaks. Align the fingerprint with the proxy location to reduce hostile treatment.
consistencyWarning.matchSuccess: Fingerprint updated to match the proxy. Relaunch the profile to apply.

cookieBot.description: Overnight profile warming on a remote machine.

locked.title: Cookie Bot
locked.hint: Cookie Bot warms your profiles overnight on a remote machine, so they keep their cookies and their history without your computer being on. It needs a paid plan.

empty.title: No profiles are enrolled
empty.hint: Pick a profile and the bot warms it overnight on a remote machine. Your computer can be off.

hours.label: Remote hours

picker.title: Enrol profiles
picker.description: Pick the profiles the bot should warm overnight.

enrol.description: The bot opens the profile on a remote machine and browses the sites you list. Your computer can be off.
enrol.summaryNightly: Runs every night at {{time}}, up to {{minutes}} min each.
enrol.summaryWeeknights: Runs Monday to Friday at {{time}}, up to {{minutes}} min each.
enrol.summaryAlternate: Runs every other night at {{time}}, up to {{minutes}} min each.
enrol.summaryCustom_one: Runs {{count}} night a week at {{time}}, up to {{minutes}} min each.
enrol.summaryCustom_other: Runs {{count}} nights a week at {{time}}, up to {{minutes}} min each.
enrol.timeHint: Local to each profile's fingerprint timezone.
enrol.sitesHint_one: {{count}} site. Only pages you list here are visited.
enrol.sitesHint_other: {{count}} sites. Only pages you list here are visited.
enrol.presetsUnavailable: Could not load the depth presets. Try again in a moment.
enrol.confirmBulkDescription_one: It books a nightly run against your shared remote hours. You choose the time and the sites next.
enrol.confirmBulkDescription_other: They book {{count}} nightly runs against your shared remote hours. You choose the time and the sites next.
enrol.curatedEmpty: No curated lists are available right now.
enrol.curatedNote: A curated list we keep up to date. Every profile draws its own sample from it, so no two profiles browse the same set — which is what stops the list itself becoming a signature. The addresses stay on our side.
enrol.savedEmpty: Nothing saved yet. Type a list under My own list, then save it from there.
enrol.savedNote: The sites are copied onto the schedule when you save it, so editing a list later leaves existing schedules alone.
enrol.savedUnavailable: Could not load your saved lists.
enrol.templateMissing: That saved list no longer exists. Pick another one.
enrol.templateNameTaken: You already have a list with that name.
enrol.templateNameInvalid: Give the list a name of {{max}} characters or fewer.
enrol.duplicateSlot: Two rows have the same days and time
enrol.summarySlots_one: Runs {{count}} time a week, up to {{minutes}} min each.
enrol.summarySlots_other: Runs {{count}} times a week, up to {{minutes}} min each.
enrol.templateNameInvalidNoMax: That name can't be used for a saved list.

prelaunchGate.intro: Review these issues with "{{name}}" before starting the browser.
prelaunchGate.fingerprintHeading: The measured exit doesn't match the fingerprint
prelaunchGate.vpnExtensionIntro: Extensions in this profile that can reroute the browser's traffic:
prelaunchGate.vpnExtensionLikely: Looks like a VPN or proxy tool
prelaunchGate.vpnExtensionExplainer: If one of these routes your traffic elsewhere, the browser's real location will no longer match the timezone, language and geolocation this profile was created with, and Donut cannot detect that from the outside.
prelaunchGate.proxyCapableHeading: Extensions that can change the proxy
prelaunchGate.proxyCapableIntro: These don't look like VPNs, but they hold Chromium's proxy permission, which download managers and debugging tools need too. Donut cannot tell whether any of them is using it:
prelaunchGate.measurementUnreliable: An extension in this profile holds the proxy permission, so the exit check may not describe the route the browser actually takes.
prelaunchGate.scanIncompleteEncrypted: This profile is encrypted, so only Donut-managed extensions could be checked.
prelaunchGate.scanIncompleteEphemeral: This profile has no data yet, so only Donut-managed extensions could be checked.
prelaunchGate.scanIncompletePartial: The extension scan was cut short, so some extensions may not be listed.
prelaunchGate.probePending: The proxy exit hasn't been measured yet. Donut will check it while starting and stop if it doesn't match.
prelaunchGate.dontBlockAgain: Don't block again for this exact mismatch
prelaunchGate.dontWarnExtensions: Don't warn again about these extensions
prelaunchGate.applyToRemaining: Apply this choice to the remaining profiles
prelaunchGate.scanIncompleteMissing: This profile has not been launched yet, so only Donut-managed extensions could be checked.
